# Frontend Design Ultra

Frontend Design Ultra is an installable Codex skill for project-aware premium frontend design, implementation, authorized browser-evidence QA, accessibility, performance, mobile craft, motion, 3D, design systems, and Awwwards-oriented art direction.

Important files:

- `frontend-design-ultra/SKILL.md`: main skill dispatcher
- `frontend-design-ultra/references/`: lazy-loaded operational protocols
- `frontend-design-ultra/scripts/inspect-project.mjs`: read-only project/starter classifier
- `frontend-design-ultra/scripts/scan-reference.mjs`: Playwright entrance/scroll/mobile/reduced-motion/video/trace capture
- `frontend-design-ultra/scripts/query-design-intelligence.mjs`: filtered reference and motion retrieval
- `frontend-design-ultra/assets/`: project-fit contracts, 76-site corpus, and 19 motion-pattern contracts
- `docs/INSTALLATION.md`: install instructions
- `docs/SKILL-CATALOG.md`: mode and workflow catalog
- `docs/AGENT-USAGE.md`: natural-language-to-parameter routing
- `docs/PARAMETERS.md`: full slash parameter reference
- `docs/platforms.md`: setup for Codex, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, Cline, Windsurf, and generic agents
- `docs/BENCHMARK.md`: dated competitive research, honest limitations, and public visual-benchmark plan
- `docs/REFERENCE_POLICY.md`: public/private evidence, reconstruction, rights, and provenance rules
- `docs/RELEASE.md`: release, GitHub settings, branch/tag protection, and artifact workflow
- `RIGHTS.md`: license boundaries, pseudonymous jury privacy, takedown, and removal workflow
- `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`: dependency-license and trademark boundaries
- `docs/assets/media-provenance.json`: exact public-media hashes, origins, redistribution status, and claim boundaries
- `benchmark/`: executable draft calibration protocol, schemas, conditions, condition blinding, and holdout tooling; results remain pending
- `showcase/`: original multi-industry reference builds; human-curated and not benchmark results
- `SELF_TEST.md`: release self-test
- `evals/`: routing and output-contract checks
- `scripts/validate-repo.mjs`: deterministic release-surface validation
- `scripts/package-release.mjs`: deterministic installable archive, manifest, and checksums
- `scripts/scan-reference-corpus.mjs`: serial local capture of selected corpus entries
- `examples/`: public example workflows

Do not treat this as a generic UI checklist. The skill is an outcome-first design operating system that should produce distinctive, evidence-backed frontend work.

When a user does not provide slash parameters, infer them from intent using `docs/AGENT-USAGE.md`.
